sources.text: Zhao Group Hongbo earned his PhD from MIT in 2021 and was a postdoc fellow at Princeton before joining UCSD in 2024. Lying at the intersection of biophysics, soft matter, active matter, physical chemistry, and applied mathematics, we aim to uncover new fundamental principles and methodologies of soft and living matter. We are particularly interested in how biomolecular condensates organize cellular components and interact with nonequilibrium activities in the cell. Leveraging statistical mechanics and data-driven approaches, we seek to discover and understand emergent phenomena in active matter.
